extDescription: Source search, novel download, and reading management.
popup_tagline: Source search, novel download, and reading management.
settings_general_appearance_desc: Customize the visual appearance of the app
settings_general_rules_desc: Configure rule update and automation behavior
settings_general_rules_autoUpdate_desc: When built-in rules are detected as outdated, automatically fetch the latest community fixes on startup
settings_general_download_desc: Configure download behavior and performance parameters
settings_general_download_concurrent_des: Controls the number of simultaneous network requests. Too high may trigger rate limiting
settings_general_shortcuts_desc: Customize app shortcuts to improve productivity
help_description: FAQs, usage guides, and troubleshooting tips.
help_toc_desc: Jump to the section you need.
help_section_overview_item1_desc: Rule-driven search and scraping. Supports enabling, importing, and exporting rules.
help_section_overview_item2_desc: Chapter caching, EPUB export, and download record management.
help_section_overview_item3_desc: Catalog parsing, volume selection, and merged export.
help_section_quickstart_step1: Go to the rules page, enable built-in rules, or import trusted ones.
help_section_quickstart_step2: Search for books in the global search and add them to your library.
help_section_quickstart_step3: Export via the Download Center or Light Novel tools.
help_section_quickstart_step4: If it fails, try switching sources or lowering the request frequency.
help_section_rules_item1_desc: JSON rules are supported. Validate with small tests first.
help_section_rules_item2_desc: Site structure changes can break rules. Update or switch sources.
help_section_rules_item3_desc: Use trusted rule sources to avoid bad results.
help_section_lightnovel_item1_desc: Merge multiple volumes into a single EPUB for easier management.
help_section_lightnovel_item2_desc: Add chapter titles at the top of each chapter for better reading.
help_section_lightnovel_item3_desc: Chapter images are written into the EPUB. Cover is auto-detected.
help_section_troubleshoot_item1_desc: Check rule status, refine keywords, or switch sources.
help_section_troubleshoot_item2_desc: Rate limits may apply. Slow down and retry later.
help_section_troubleshoot_item3_desc: Test with a small range before full export.
help_contact_hint: Rule ID / URL / time / steps to reproduce
help_contact_githubDesc: View project source, submit issues, or join discussions on GitHub
help_contact_emailDesc: Send feedback or suggestions via email. Include detailed information for easier troubleshooting
about_description: Version info, feature overview, and usage guidelines
about_app_desc: Current extension version and runtime environment
about_app_coreValue: Rule management, search, download, light novel packing
about_app_modeValue: Local parsing and storage, on-demand network access
about_scope_rules_desc: Import, export, enable, and disable rules for search, catalog, and chapter scraping.
about_scope_download_desc: Chapter caching, batch EPUB export, download records, and history stats.
about_scope_lightnovel_desc: Catalog parsing, volume selection, merged packing, and chapter title injection.
about_privacy_local_desc: Book caches, download records, and rule configs are stored locally in the browser.
about_privacy_network_desc: Only target sites are accessed during search, scraping, and download. No local data is uploaded.
about_privacy_permissions_desc: Permissions are used solely for core extension features (page access, storage, download), not for tracking or ads.
about_guidelines_rate_desc: Too frequent requests may trigger site restrictions. Use default concurrency and intervals.
about_guidelines_rules_desc: Verify third-party rule sources before importing to avoid errors or unwanted scraping.
about_guidelines_feedback_desc: For scraping failures or rule issues, record the failing URL and error message for debugging.
about_support_desc: Get help or report an issue
about_support_hint: Include the page URL, rule ID, and time range for faster debugging.
